column1: # The Chapter III conformity record: for each obligation Articles 25 to 30,
# 36 to 41 and 49 of Regulation (EU) 2025/327 place on the manufacturer of
# an EHR system, and for each item of Annex IV (the EU declaration of
# conformity), where FerroFED stands, the evidence and the issue that closes
# any gap. The Annex II essential requirements have their own checklist,
# conformance/annex-ii.tsv, and the Annex III elements their own index,
# conformance/technical-documentation.tsv; a row here points at them.
# Columns: provision (Art N(p)(x), Art N(x) or Annex IV n); requirement (a
# phrase of that provision's own text in the vendored Regulation); applies
# (the Art 105 date it applies from: 2027, 2029+2031 or 2031); status (met,
# open, awaits-act, manufacturer or not-applicable); evidence (one or more
# items separated by "; ", each a file of this repository, followed by "::"
# and a heading of it for a Markdown file or the name of a test function
# for a Rust file); issue (-, or #N and Owner/Repo#N separated by one
# space, required for open, awaits-act and manufacturer); note (what is
# A provision may have more than one row when each quotes a different
